notes.title: QR DEAD. Update.
notes.content:
Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki. 😎

We have prepared an update for QR DEAD.

1. Removed unnecessary settings from the menu.
2. Corrected text errors.
3. Improved operation of the phone.
4. Improved loading of graphics in the menu.
5. Removed generation of a new character in the first qr code for the riddle with the box.
6. Fixed a bug with a claw hammer.
7. Improved save system.
8. Removed the ability to pick up herbs in two places without solving riddles.
9. One of the castles did not have the ability to interact with arrows, added.
10. Added a tooltip so you can focus on key houses right away.
11. fixed collisions.
12. Improved sounds.
13. Fixed other minor bugs
